prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across multiple tests, triggering guardrail rollbacks.
Finish screen layout changes consistently degraded performance across multiple tests.
Sign-in redesigns consistently hurt performance, resulting in significant losses and no winning tests.
Sign-in hints, adoption new screens, and home wait-info features proved helpful by driving multiple winning tests, though most home wait-info tests showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the gains achieved by winning tests.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_troubleshooter_wait_info: Displays system tray and taskbar hotkey tips on the waiting screen in case the pet asset load is delayed. (why: Support received multiple reports of pets failing to appear on the desktop or screen stalling during asset initialization.)
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_pet_recovery_hint: Adds reassurance text explaining that signing into an existing account automatically restores all previously adopted pets. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) involved users losing or resetting pets after re-signing into the app.)
2: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_fast_login_reassurance_copy: Updates headline and body copy to emphasize quick cloud sync without long wait times. (why: Sign-in step takes a mean time of 567s and exhibits stalls during initial account linking.)
3: [home, notification] waiting_background_preparation_notification: Enables a system tray notification option that alerts users as soon as desktop pet rendering completes. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and miss when their pet is ready.)
4: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_mode_recommendation_hint: Adds a helpful hint describing the difference between quick preset pets and custom avatar creation. (why: Users take a long mean time (514s) at path selection trying to decide between custom and preset pet paths.)
5: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_controls_summary_copy: Clarifies exact mouse actions (right-click to interact, tray icon to hide) in the final setup completion screen. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, talk to, or temporarily hide their pet after setup.)
